senses.sense_definition: The act of providing physical care and emotional support, especially to children or dependents.

examples.text: The child thrived under the constant <w>nurturance</w> of her loving parents.

target_lang_translations.ru: Ребенок расцвел благодаря постоянной <w>заботе</w> своих любящих родителей.
target_lang_translations.de: Das Kind gedieh prächtig unter der ständigen <w>Fürsorge</w> seiner liebevollen Eltern.

examples.text: Psychologists emphasize the importance of early emotional <w>nurturance</w> for healthy development.

target_lang_definitions.de: Die Handlung, körperliche Fürsorge und emotionale Unterstützung zu leisten, insbesondere für Kinder oder Schutzbefohlene.

senses.sense_definition: The process of encouraging the growth, development, or success of something.

examples.text: The school is dedicated to the <w>nurturance</w> of artistic talent in young students.

target_lang_translations.ru: Школа посвящает себя <w>развитию</w> художественных талантов у юных учеников.

examples.text: Successful innovation requires the careful <w>nurturance</w> of new ideas within the company.
